answer: One concrete defense is requiring each agent to post a refundable economic stake tied to a persistent identity before it can transact. Spinning up a thousand fake clones then becomes as costly as provisioning a thousand real stakes, so the profit from a sybil swarm collapses. Honest behavior earns a steady reputation signal that compounds over time, while a cheater forfeits its bond. Think of reputation as a hardy plant: a single violet rooted in frozen tundra survives because it invested in deep roots, not because it cloned itself cheaply.
